reviews.author: Nur Darar
reviews.text: I seriously can’t thank Scott enough for all his help when I was stuck on the side of the road with a flat tire. He was there within minutes and drove me around and made sure I got the correct tire for my car. Most people wouldn’t go to the lengths he did to help me out. Thank you so much Scott. Highly recommend ABC Towing of Lexington.

reviews.author: Lauren Murphy
reviews.text: I was miles from home. Feeling destitute on the side of the road. I called up ABC Towing and knew they had my back. He arrived asap and quickly loaded my Jeep. He brought it to my home. We have trusted ABC in the past with other vehicles. They are our #1 tower in Davidson County.

reviews.author: Mandy Lawson
reviews.text: Towed vehicles from a traffic stop we understand they are doing their job. However the man. Must have been overwhelmed with the amount of calls he had. Gave us the run around to get paperwork needed on a truck got it. Wouldn't realse a trailer without binded title which is illegal bc proof of ownership was there. The man pushed up on my husband and when he mentioned calling the cops he did also. He thre my husband's belonging out of a truck and on to the ground. Whcuh is damage to personal property. Dude is extremely rude and back and forth with his mood. We are looking into hiring a lawyer for damages to property and asking for camera footage as well. This man is scamming people. Edit to add our attorney asked us to call and ask for possesion of our winch since its filed in state taxes as a business expense and not welded to the trailer. His response is no because he doesn't want to and because I left this review. Im so glad i have recorded everything Edit to add again 4.45 pm. He called offered to give the winch back if the review is taken down. We retained an attorney for legal advice and called to ask if that was OK to do and just be done with it all together. We called back and he stated he changed his mind AGAIN. Which verifies the back and forth I mentioned originally. This is proof of everything we have been going thru were done with the trailer issue we dont want ir at the point but the item thst were filed on that state tax return is possession of the business owned.

reviews.author: Thomas Groves
reviews.text: Today I had a customer come through and his vehicle decided to take a break from working. I assisted the customer with a few phone calls to get a towing service to help him. After not getting any positive results I just called them. Scott took the call asked some questions and said he would be here in 30 minutes and he was. Very polite and a very great experience overall. I normally don’t do this just felt they needed to know that their customer service was appreciated all around. Thank you again for the great experience and response.

reviews.author: Tanner Colbert
reviews.text: I called ABC Towing because my little sister’s car broke down, and they were fantastic to work with. The driver was very attentive and got to us as quickly as he could. The owner was great to talk to, super nice guy and very professional. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tonia Force
reviews.text: These are the best people. This is the only tow company we call any time we need help. They don't take advantage of you when they know you're in a bad situation. All the other companies charge astronomical prices because they know you don't have a choice. But ABC Towing is always fair and reasonable on their pricing. They also use care in dealing with your vehicle. I never have to worry about additional damage from the tow truck company. I will pick ABC Towing everytime!

reviews.author: Justin Benfield
reviews.text: Scott went above and beyond. We own a little mom and pop delivery company from Florida and we were picking up a load in NC, the roads were iced and my driver got stuck in a bad spot. All around bad situation. Scott went above and beyond in a very difficult situation and exhausted all options. He was able to get us out and my driver safe. Five stars isn't enough he deserves 10. Thanks for everything!

reviews.author: Jennifer Ridenhour
reviews.text: Very nice and pleasant to deal with. Was there to get my car off of a very busy highway in a timely manner. I highly recommend ABC towing for all your towing needs.

reviews.author: Kenneth Miller
reviews.text: ABC Towing was great I had a wreck driver was very helpful. They were so accommodating with helping with getting all I needed. These are great people I recommend them to all my friends and family. Awesome company to work with

reviews.author: Corey Force
reviews.text: I have used this company for about 6 years , they have been nothing but awesome, always fair prices. Always there quickly. I recommend ABC towing to ally friends and family

reviews.author: Alisha Bailey
reviews.text: They are so amazing and professional very friendly. They did a great job getting to me to tow my car where it needed to go! I would use them again

reviews.author: Brittany Tignor
reviews.text: Scott answered our call right away, came out very quickly. Very reasonable and helped think of different ways to resolve our issue the safest way possible!!! Would definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: John Ijames II
reviews.text: Scott was helpful in recommending a good repair shop for my son's Hyundai. Thanks brother I appreciate that.

reviews.author: Josh Vazquez
reviews.text: I had a great experience with abc towing! He was amazing and very polite and very helpful went above and beyond!

reviews.author: James Jump
reviews.text: Smart aleck driver. Pulled in and parked behind car he had hooked in Food Lion parking lot. I asked driver if I would be in his way there and he came back hateful talking saying you're gonna do what you want anyway. Never seen the man before, I'm a 68 year old handicapped man that can't walk good , no need for him to talk to me that way

reviews.author: Kevin Tracy
reviews.text: Scott was excellent with the service he provided to me today. I will continue to use ABC Towing for all my towing needs. Made me feel like home and didn’t seem like a hassle. Thank you Scott and ABC Towing!

reviews.author: David Smith
reviews.text: Great service! Called in an emergency late on Friday. Answered quickly and got right on it after multiple other companies didn’t follow through.

reviews.author: Maribel Lopez
reviews.text: if it was for me i would give 100 stars !! We encountered with the owner Scott Very well good experience always attended , attending with our calls and questions we had ! Always giving us his own feedback about our situation that happen that our car got towed and had horrible damage but since day ONE he been Amazing thank you ABC TOWING from lexington for everything you have help us in these hard couples of weeks we have had ! thank you i will be recommending you !

reviews.author: William Miller
reviews.text: Great service. Definitely went above and beyond any other company I used! I will recommend them to my family and friends every time.

reviews.author: Emilie Stroupe
reviews.text: Scott is an angel! I called everywhere in Lexington trying to to find help and he was willing to tow my car for $25 cheaper than any other tow place in Lexington! CALL HIM! he can help you for a more than fair price!! Thanks Scott!!!

reviews.author: Abdo Shawky
reviews.text: I wish there was a Zero star review, I would gladly give it to that man, he was so mean as much as you can imagine, He towed my car from Hardee's to his place which is literly 1 mile ( one mile ) and he charged me 300$ and tried nicely to get a cut as it is not fair at all to pay 300$ for one mile towing and was only 2 hours at his place ( did not stay any over night ( no storage fees ). I had to call the police cus he did not want to give me my car at the end cus I told him that this is a scam and will about it and he gave me the car and took 300$ only when he knew police were coming. I would never ever recommend him to anyone as he is so mean and a scammer !

reviews.author: Kelly Vincent
reviews.text: I used this towing service and Scott went out of his way to help me… and did it very quickly!!! I would HIGHLY recommended this company to anyone out there needing help! He also gave me some great advice when it came to my car and the situation I was in. Thank you Scott for your top notch service..!!!

reviews.author: Nichelle Moore
reviews.text: ABC towing helped out a friend of mine today who was stuck on the side of the road with a transmission issue. They were so kind and helpful to her. She was so stressed and worried and they treated her with such care and kindness.

reviews.author: Tlynn Cook
reviews.text: ABC Towing was great! I really appreciate them They helped me out today and were very compassionate. I was very stressed and greatly appreciated the extra kindness.

reviews.author: Stacy Oates
reviews.text: Excellent service. I forgot to put my handbrake on and Scott was able to get my car out of a precarious position after it rolled off a raised area. Timely arrival and great, friendly service.

reviews.author: nicole thompson
reviews.text: Car was on a trailer at the end of private cul-de-sac less than 24hrs. And told me it would be $1700 and hung up on me

reviews.author: bbrifle
reviews.text: Cannot speak any higher about ABC towing , great company , got me out of a bind when my water pump went out HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Lauren Schenck
reviews.text: My mom locked her keys in her car recently and contacted ABC Towing for assistance. Scott, the ABC Towing manager, arrived in promptly in under 10 minutes and unlocked her car successfully. Thanks you to Scott and ABC Towing for helping my mom in this situation and for coming to the rescue so quickly.
